The Warriors defeated the Pelicans, 138-87 tonight in Golden State. Stephen Curry finished with a team-high 25 points along with 5 rebounds and 4 three pointers for the Warriors, while Brandin Podziemski tallied 25 points, 5 three pointers and 4 assists in the game. Derik Queen recorded 16 points, 3 blocks and 4 rebounds. The Warriors improve their record to 8-3 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 4-7 for the season.
